title: Complete transcriptomic landscape of prostate cancer in the Chinese population using RNA-seq

atlas_processing.source_statement: Expression Atlas mapped reads to Ensembl release 107 with TopHat2 2.1.1 and quantified them with HTSeq 0.11.0. Exact FASTA and annotation hashes remain to be pinned.
atlas_processing.diagnostic_baseline: Diagnostic OLS on log2(median-ratio-normalized counts + 1), sampling site with individual fixed effects; DESeq2 confirmation remains required.

verified_resources.format_check: Every retained count parsed as a non-negative integer; repeated run columns, where present, were accepted only after full-vector equality checks.
Analysed run identifiers are present, unique and represented in the retained count matrix.

obligations: Cite the current Expression Atlas publication requested on the licence page.
Retain the experiment accession and originating-study link.

reference_review.reported_processing: Expression Atlas mapped reads to Ensembl release 107 with TopHat2 2.1.1 and quantified them with HTSeq 0.11.0. Exact FASTA and annotation hashes remain to be pinned.
reference_review.pending: Pin exact assembly FASTA and annotation file URLs, sizes and SHA-256 checksums, then verify every pocket identifier against the annotation.

reduction_diagnostic.interpretation: The 8,000-gene candidate is the first declared size to meet all four development thresholds.

remaining_work: Pin exact reference files and validate the pocket identifier namespace against them.
Run the DESeq2 full-source and pocket confirmation with recorded versions.
Prepare dataset-level source attribution and license files.
Complete an independent clean-environment reproduction before release.
